create_FastTextEmbeddingBag: create a FastTextEmbeddingBag from a fasttext model file path for use as a PyTorch module
build_FastTextEmbeddingBag_forward: build word embeddings by passing a list of words to a FastTextEmbeddingBag instance
test_FastTextEmbeddingBag: test that FastTextEmbeddingBag outputs match fasttext model word vectors
create_random_word: create a random word of a given length using uppercase, lowercase, and digits
load_fasttext_model: load a fasttext model from a binary file to access word vectors and subwords
